title: Launch orchestration scenarios and cut-decision framework for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a decision-ready playbook that defines milestone gates, objective cut criteria, and three realistic launch scenarios (greenfield on-time, trimmed-scope ship, and staged canary with holdback) covering API, Console, and Runtime components. This ticket coordinates cross-functional decision points, release notes ownership, and a single source of truth for downstream GTM tasks. The output will be a matrix (milestone x signal) and a short simulation doc to be used by PMs, Eng leads, Design, and GTM for the next release cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone matrix produced listing scope-lock, code freeze, cutline, regression gates, and rollback triggers for API/Console/Runtime
Cut criteria defined with quantitative signals (latency P50/P95 thresholds, error budget consumption %, failing e2e tests count, release blocker bugs) and clear owners
Three launch scenarios documented with decision trees and example timelines
Release notes owner assigned for each component and a template created for consolidated release notes
Stakeholder alignment session completed with recorded decisions and an action list assigned
tasks: Draft milestone matrix and propagate to ENG/DES/SEC/GTM for feedback
Collect runtime perf SLOs and recent regressions from Observability console
Define quantitative cut metrics and map to owners (e.g., infra for latency, runtime team for resource regressions)
Create release notes template and map component owners
Run a dry-run decision table with two simulated failure scenarios and record outcomes
Publish final playbook to Confluence and notify GTM/Support/CS
timeline: 2025-02-20: Ticket created and initial draft of milestone matrix completed
2025-02-22: Eng review with runtime and api teams — requested stricter latency thresholds for P95
2025-02-24: Design review scheduled; stakeholder alignment workshop planned for 2025-02-27
2025-03-10: Finalize playbook and release notes template
2025-03-14: Playbook published and GTM notified (due date)
rollout_plan: Primary scenario (greenfield on-time): Proceed with full scope if all gates pass by code-freeze. GTM publishes full feature list.
Trimmed-scope ship: Identify safe subset of Console/API feature toggles; postpone Runtime heavy-ops features to next release; GTM prepares a targeted notes set and customer communication template.
Staged canary with holdback: Roll Console and API to 25% initially; hold Runtime heavy features behind feature gates; monitor latency/error budget for 48 hours before progressive rollout.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Runtime regression under long-tail traffic patterns. Mitigation: Increase e2e load tests and enable K/V cache telemetry; define rollback plan to previous model shard.
Risk: API breaking change discovered late. Mitigation: Add compatibility smoke tests and require API contract sign-off by eng leads 72h before code freeze.
Risk: Incomplete release notes causing GTM confusion. Mitigation: Mandatory release notes draft with owner assignment two weeks before ship window and a single consolidated doc owner.
decisions: Adopt numeric cut thresholds: P50 latency < 80ms, P95 latency < 350ms for 99th percentile customers; error budget burn not to exceed 5% in the 48h window
Rollout default: staged canary for Runtime, full for minor Console/UIs where feature flags exist
Release notes consolidation: PM to own final consolidated notes; component owners to provide 1-paragraph summary + risk callouts
next_steps: Finalize matrix incorporating Eng feedback by 2025-02-26
